Traffic Congestion on Sidcul Roads Due to Truck Parking

Trucks are causing traffic jams on the roads of Sidcul, despite the availability of parking facilities. Malwahak (goods carriers) are being parked along the roadside, leading to congestion. Authorities have warned of difficulties if jams are created in markets and have indicated strict enforcement regarding parking and PUC (Pollution Under Control) certificates, with action to be taken against officials.
